answer: Resist sybils with rotating pairwise duel challenges. Each epoch a beacon pairs identities; partners get complementary puzzle halves that must solve inside one tight window and combine into one checksum. Running both seats still burns two parallel compute streams that window; a miss on either half forfeits both partners attestation pay. The velvet margin: N clones need N/2 concurrent duel slots of real hardware — shared cores fail the signal timing, and rented burst VMs cannot keep a lotus of durable pairings across epochs without paying full per-seat compute.
